does_not_cover: Entropy, information gain and ID3 never appear; no classification tree is ever built despite the genre.
Bagging, random forests, boosting and stacking are absent; pruning is reduced to a minimum-node-size stopping rule, never post-pruning.
notes: Prerequisites assumed: bias-variance trade-off, decision-tree basics, least squares. Notation: SSR for sum of squared residuals. Example uses min-size 7 as a stand-in for the usual 20.

segments.topic: Motivation: straight lines fail on nonlinear dose-response data
Reading predictions as leaf averages from a finished tree
Multi-predictor trees: dosage plus age plus sex
Split search: trying thresholds, minimizing squared residuals, root at 14.5
Recursive splitting, minimum node size, and the overfitting warning
Comparing candidate splits across predictors for the root
Recap of the build recipe and leaf rule

suggested_locator: 06:59-12:58 for the split-search procedure; 13:11-18:41 for overfitting and stopping

teaches.why: Builds and reads decision-tree rules mapping dosage, age, sex to predictions.
Derives splits by minimizing squared residuals with leaf-average outputs throughout.
Covers growth control via minimum node size, but never shows post-pruning.
